summary: User received a fraudulent email impersonating OpenSea claiming that a buyer had offered 0.75 ETH for an NFT and directing the recipient to access offer details. The email originated from an unrelated Gmail address and was intended to lure the user through a fake offer notification.
prevention: Verify NFT offers directly through the official marketplace instead of email links / Check the sender address before acting on marketplace notifications
classification_warning: attempted phishing with no confirmed interaction or financial loss
